ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 80% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels and 20% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels localized at the distal tips and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blocks across the central visible area of both lobes. Low-intensity black contiguous banding along the leading edges and distal tips. Three distinct, vertically-aligned low-intensity focal spots visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the trailing edge of the right lobe, with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching 10-20 pixels. The left lobe trailing edge is partially obscured by water-surface diffraction and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible portions of the trailing edges follow a generally convex curve towards the tips, with the right lobe showing a sharp downward vector as it enters the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast, heterogeneous clusters of textured circular masses (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips and along the trailing edges of both lobes. Several small, dark-pixel circular spots on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of barnacles on the fluke tips and trailing edges, causing significant physical protrusion and altering the baseline geometric perimeter of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe features a distinct pattern of three dark, oval-shaped pigment spots arranged in a vertical column near the medial edge.
